'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
****[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] gunfire and airstrikes kill at least 21 [[Palestinians]] across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 11 people seeking [[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war|aid assistance]]. [https://aje.io/7sgjqa?update=3789826 (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[European Union]] [[European External Action Service]] finds that Israel may have breached its [[human rights]] obligations under the terms of the [[Israel–European Union relations|EU-Israel Association]] agreement governing its ties with the EU. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/20/israels-gaza-actions-may-breach-eu-israel-human-rights-agreement-report (Al Jazeera)]
***[[President of Turkey|Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] announces the [[UNRWA]] will open an office in [[Turkey]]'s capital, [[Ankara]]. [https://aje.io/7sgjqa?update=3790087 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Twelve-Day War]] 
***The death toll from [[Israel]]'s strikes on [[Iran]] rises to more than 430, while 3,056 people have been injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/21/live-iran-says-still-open-to-diplomacy-israel-vows-continued-attacks (Al Jazeera)]
***Iran's [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education|health minister]] [[Mohammad-Reza Zafarghandi|Mohammadreza Zafarghandi]] says Israel has targeted three hospitals during the conflict, killing two health workers and a child, and has targeted six [[ambulance]]s. [https://aje.io/7sgjqa?update=3789705 (Al Jazeera)]
***Iran's emergency organization head says Israeli strikes have targeted [[medical]] and relief facilities, in addition to residential areas across the country. Three relief bases and eight ambulances have been seriously damaged or destroyed. [https://aje.io/7sgjqa?update=3789926 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Netherlands]] officially returns 119 sculptures from the [[Benin Bronzes]] collection that were [[looted art|looted]] from the [[Kingdom of Benin]] in present-day [[Edo State]], [[Nigeria]], by [[British Colonial Auxiliary Forces|British colonial forces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/21/the-netherlands-returns-119-stolen-sculptures-to-nigeria (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.okayafrica.com/nigerian-artefact-returned-by-netherlands/ (OkayAfrica)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Santa Catarina hot air balloon crash]]
**At least eight people are killed and 13 others are injured in a hot air balloon accident in [[Praia Grande, Santa Catarina|Praia Grande]], [[Santa Catarina (state)|Santa Catarina]], [[Brazil]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2025/06/21/americas/dead-hot-air-balloon-accident-brazil-intl (CNN)] [https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-eight-killed-13-injured-in-hot-air-balloon-crash/a-72995835 (DW)]
*Six people are killed and two others are missing after a boat carrying ten people capsizes on [[Lake Tahoe]] in the [[Sierra Nevada]], United States. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/6-dead-2-missing-boat-capsizes-lake-tahoe-rcna214511 (NBC News)]
*Three people are killed and 81 others are injured after a barrier collapsed in [[Stade du 5 Juillet]] in [[Algeria]], in a match between [[MC Alger]] and [[NC Magra]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3en3nzlxxxo (BBC News)]

**[[Belarus]]ian [[President of Belarus|president]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] pardons several opposition figures, including opposition leader [[Siarhei Tsikhanouski]], following a deal brokered by U.S. special envoy to Ukraine [[Keith Kellogg]]. **[[Pakistan]] announces that it will formally nominate [[U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] for a [[Nobel Peace Prize]], citing his mediation during the [[2025 India–Pakistan conflict]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwyx5yw8y28o (BBC News)]
